highlights: Comprehensive annual safeguarding training for all staff
Stringent background checks for all personnel
Child protection policies aligned with international best practices
Mandatory safeguarding policy acknowledgement for staff and families
safety.policy_summary: Panyaden International School places the highest priority on the safety, protection, and well-being of every child, upholding rigorous international standards for child protection. All staff members undergo comprehensive annual safeguarding training and stringent background checks. The safeguarding approach is proactive and ethical, grounded in Buddhist values of compassion, mindfulness, and wisdom, with active participation required from staff, students, and families.
